properties.name: app.proofs.cleanup.enabled
properties.description: Enables scheduled cleanup of expired proof uploads and stale proof drafts.

properties.name: app.articles.media-cleanup.enabled
properties.description: Enables scheduled cleanup of orphaned article media from the public S3 bucket.

properties.name: app.articles.media-cleanup-cron
properties.description: Cron expression for scheduled article media cleanup.

properties.name: app.game-config.object-prefix
properties.description: Public S3 object prefix where admin-managed game JSON configuration files are stored.

properties.name: app.game-config.releases-object-prefix
properties.description: Public S3 object prefix where versioned game JSON configuration releases and latest metadata are stored.

properties.name: spring.session.store-type
properties.description: Spring Session backing store. Use 'redis' in production and 'none' in tests.

properties.name: spring.session.redis.namespace
properties.description: Redis key namespace used by Spring Session.
